summary: Two Palestinians were injured in two separate incidents when settlers threw stones at Palestinian vehicles.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 20 Mar 2023; WAFA 20 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 27 Mar 2023; PLO NAD March 2023 monthly report
resolution_notes: The Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat component is already canonical as ILPV-2023-0323. For the Deir Istiya component, NAD's daily report explicitly covers 08:00 Mar.26–08:00 Mar.27 and timestamps the exact attack at 13:50, and its monthly reporting also dates the incident Mar.26. OCHA's aggregate treatment had suggested Mar.27, so preserve that source discrepancy but use Mar.26 as the best-supported event date. Independent exact-event corroboration outside the Palestinian monitoring/derivative lane remains insufficient; keep Unresolved and do not accept by inference.
media_status: No exact/original visual media recovered for the unresolved Deir Istiya component; no generic imagery used.
